Dashboard vs QBO monthly, from the P&L (QBO) tab

Dashboard figures come from the Invoice tab (Total Due, net of discounts). QBO figures come from the P&L extract, income net of the discount accounts per line. QBO does not split direct labor or income between Tox and other injectables, so both are compared as one Injectables group. Gift cards, deposits and fees (Other) are excluded from the comparison because QBO treats them as liabilities or other income, and Misc Income and Rebates are shown as memo lines only.
